hook: The saddle-shaped Allen-Cahn solution in even dimensions 8 and up is a global minimizer.
summary: The authors prove that the Cabre-Terra saddle solution of the Allen-Cahn equation in dimension 2m, for m at least 4, minimizes energy globally. Up to sign it is the only minimizer whose nodal set approaches the Simons cone with faster-than-Hardt-Simon decay. The result is specific to these even dimensions.
title: A uniqueness theorem for Allen--Cahn global minimizers asymptotic to the Simons cone
